posts.descEn: What do you see every time you open a new tab in your browser? Full screen push news, pop-up ads, and a variety of content recommendations. Many start pages are constantly stacked with functions, turning the new tab page into an information flow plaza. We only want to search quickly, but we are wrapped up in all kinds of information and our attention is constantly chopped up.
posts.titleZh: 我做了一个极简浏览器主页，告别广告与信息轰炸
posts.descZh: 每次打开浏览器新建标签页，你会看到什么？满屏推送新闻、弹窗广告、五花八门的内容推荐。很多起始页不断堆砌功能，把新标签页变成信息流广场，我们本只想快速搜索，却被各种信息裹挟，注意力被不断切碎。
